slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: plan_start
slots.about: the plan's first day; week 1 is the week (from first_weekday) that holds it

slots.name: weeks
slots.about: how many weeks the plan has

slots.name: sessions
slots.about: planned sessions, at most one a day: id, date, name, done

slots.name: day_names
slots.about: seven short day names, Sunday first, in the app's language

slots.name: of_word
slots.about: between the week number and the plan's length

slots.name: rest_word
slots.about: the row name on a day with no session

slots.name: next_word
slots.about: status under the first session not done, today or later

slots.name: missed_word
slots.about: status under a past session not done

slots.name: mark_word
slots.about: spoken before a session on its ring when not done

slots.name: unmark_word
slots.about: spoken before a session on its ring when done

slots.name: previous_label
slots.about: spoken on the previous week button

slots.name: next_label
slots.about: spoken on the next week button

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when the plan has no session at all

empty.shows: empty under the week; every day reads rest

fallback.shows: a rest row: rest_word in a quiet colour, no status, no ring, no fill

attention.shows: the next session says next_word in accent; past ones not done say missed_word; today's badge fills

labels.ring: mark_word or unmark_word and the session

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: Week 1 is the first_weekday week that holds plan_start; paging moves from the current week and stops at 1 and weeks. Only today's or past sessions can be marked; the ring is not shown on later days.
